scores.turnaround_score: equal-weight percentile composite of falling prior drift (-prior) and rising recent drift
scores.recent_drift_3m: reference: recent 3-month drift alone (rising now, whatever came before)
scores.prior_fall_9m: reference: -prior drift alone (fell the most before the recent 3 months)

baskets.turned_up: prior drift < 0 and recent drift > 0, equal weight
baskets.deep_turn: prior drift in the bottom third and recent drift in the top third of the universe, equal weight
baskets.turned_up_top50: the 50 highest turnaround_score stocks among turned_up

note: US index union, monthly rebalancing, next-open entry, 0.05% one-way cost on basket turnover. Definitions fixed before running; all are reported.
